wallet.delete_confirm: Delete the wallet? This is irreversible — make sure on-chain funds have been transferred out first!
wallet.configured_note: Wallet configured, encrypted in local database
wallet.not_configured: No wallet configured. Create or import one.
wallet.pk_note: Private keys are encrypted with WALLET_MASTER_PASSWORD and decrypted in memory only at trade execution time.
wallet.create_form_desc: The system will generate a 12-word mnemonic and derive addresses for SOL / BSC / ETH / XLAYER.
wallet.create_form_warn: The mnemonic is shown only once — back it up immediately!
wallet.import_form_desc: Enter 12 or 24 English words separated by spaces. The system will validate and encrypt them.
wallet.backup_warn_title: Back up the mnemonic NOW. You will not be able to view it again after closing this page.
wallet.backup_warn_subtitle: Write the 12 words below on paper, in order, and store them safely.
wallet.backup_confirm_label: I have written down the mnemonic and understand it cannot be recovered if lost.
wallet.backup_confirm_btn: I've backed it up — close this notice
wallet.security_item_1: The mnemonic is AES-256 encrypted and stored in the local database; the key is derived from WALLET_MASTER_PASSWORD in .env.
wallet.security_item_2: Private keys are decrypted in memory only during trade execution — never written to logs or files.
wallet.security_item_3: We recommend creating a small dedicated trading wallet rather than using a main wallet holding significant assets.
wallet.security_item_4: Withdraw profits to a cold wallet on a regular schedule.

sweep.title: Sweep Residual Tokens
sweep.desc: Scan historical positions for tokens with remaining balance in the wallet and attempt to sell them all to recover funds.
sweep.confirm: This will scan all historical positions, find tokens with remaining balance, and attempt to sell them. Progress is shown below. Confirm?

config.page_subtitle: All thresholds are hot-reloaded — saving applies instantly without restart

bot.title: Bot Status
bot.desc: When enabled, listens to CA signals and decides on buys via the toggles below
bot.auto_buy_desc: ON: any CA passing filters is auto-bought (global params); OFF: only execute signals from configured copy-trade callers
bot.batch_follow_desc: When on, the leaderboard shows a One-click follow button to batch-add follow configs
bot.status_auto: Auto-buy ON — any CA passing filters will be bought
bot.status_follow: Follow mode — only configured callers will trigger buys
bot.status_paused: Stopped — observe-only, no buys or sells executed

api.title: API Configuration
api.desc: Click save after editing — applies instantly, no restart
api.key_set: API key is set (admin permission required to view)

ai.title: AI Assistant Endpoint
ai.desc: Configure the LLM endpoint used by the AI assistant
ai.custom_note: (built-in key in use, this serves as fallback)

trade.title: Trade Parameters
trade.buy_amount_hint: Enter the amount in U; each chain auto-converts: BSC/ETH use USDT, BASE/XLAYER use USDC, SOL is converted at live price
trade.max_concurrent_hint: Maximum positions held at the same time
trade.fallback_desc: Retry once with a larger amount if the original buy fails
trade.fallback_amount_hint: Original {{base}}U fails → retry with this amount
trade.precheck_desc: Quote first to validate the contract — filters invalid/illiquid tokens to save gas
trade.precheck_on: ON: Tokens that fail pre-check are skipped, no transaction sent
trade.precheck_off: OFF: Skip pre-check, attempt buy directly — error only surfaces when the contract is invalid
trade.cooldown_hint: Don't retry the same CA for this duration after failure (0=no cooldown; 300 recommended)
trade.bnb_title: Use BNB instead of USDT (BSC only)
trade.bnb_desc: If the wallet has insufficient USDT, auto-buy with the equivalent BNB amount
trade.bnb_on: ON: Auto-switch to BNB at live price (60s cache) when USDT is insufficient
trade.bnb_off: OFF: Skip with error when USDT is insufficient

sell.title: Exit Strategy
sell.tp_hint: Sell automatically when gain reaches this value
sell.sl_hint: Sell automatically when loss reaches this value

dashboard.title: Dashboard Display
dashboard.live_log_desc: When off, the right log panel collapses to free up space
dashboard.price_cached_desc: Use the monitor's last polled price (≤10s lag), no API cost
dashboard.price_realtime_desc: Call AVE API on refresh to fetch the latest price

sender.title: Filter · Caller Quality
sender.desc: All checked conditions must hold for a buy to fire
sender.global_winrate_hint: Caller's historical share of tokens up >20%
sender.group_winrate_hint: Caller's win rate within this group (active once field ships)
sender.total_tokens_hint: Win rate is unreliable on a small sample
sender.best_mult_hint: Caller has hit at least one big runner in the past
sender.new_sender: How to handle callers with no history

anti_fomo.title: Filter · Anti-FOMO
anti_fomo.current_mult_hint: Skip if the CA already pumped above this multiple at signal time

heat.title: Filter · Propagation Heat
heat.global_count_hint: Total sends of this CA across all groups
heat.local_count_hint: Send count in the current group
heat.groups_hint: How many groups mention this CA
heat.queries_hint: Active personal lookups for this CA

market.title: Filter · Market Data
market.holders_hint: Too few holders means thin liquidity

safety.title: Filter · Safety (recommended always-on)
safety.honeypot_desc: Skip tokens detected as honeypots (strongly recommended)
safety.unknown_desc: Newly listed tokens not yet scanned — high rug risk
safety.unknown_skip_warn: All unchecked tokens are skipped — safer, but you'll miss some new listings
safety.unknown_allow_warn: Allowing unchecked tokens carries high rug risk — recommended only for short-term testing
safety.risk_hint: AVE risk score, lower is safer
safety.max_holder_hint: zzb field, prevents concentrated whale control

spend.title: Spend Limit
spend.desc: Cumulative buy within the time window cannot exceed the configured cap
spend.limit_hint: Max total buy amount within window

repeat.title: Repeat-buy Policy
repeat.allow_desc: Off by default — once a CA has been bought and closed, it is not bought again
repeat.delta_hint: Trigger repeat buy when global send count grows by at least this much (20 recommended)
repeat.delta_example: e.g. 20 = the same CA must show ≥20 new global sends since last signal to repeat-buy

chain.title: Enabled Chains (priority left→right)
chain.swap_mult_hint: 1.0=track live network price; >1.0 faster but pricier
chain.broadcast_desc: Controls how signed txs are submitted on-chain
chain.broadcast_ave_desc: Broadcast via AVE servers after simulation, gasPrice ≥ 1 Gwei, MEV-protected
chain.broadcast_direct_desc: Skip AVE simulation, send raw tx directly. Gas tracks live network — 10–15× cheaper
chain.broadcast_direct_note: gasPrice tracks the live network (BSC ~0.07 Gwei), ~$0.02–0.03 per tx. Note: no AVE simulation, honeypots may revert and burn gas.
chain.broadcast_ave_note: Simulated upfront — catches 3025 errors, gasPrice forced ≥ 1 Gwei, ~$0.2–0.3 per tx.

wallet_link.desc: Create, import, and view per-chain addresses
